sizing_summary: Baseline QPS: 30 sustained across core chat endpoints (api/v1/chat) assumed 3 replicas routing to same pool.
Average tokens per response (median): 120 tokens; average request tokens (median): 45 tokens.
Target latency SLOs: chat p50 < 60ms, p95 < 220ms at 1024 context; embeddings p95 < 120ms; batch job p95 < 1s.
Steady-state token/sec (system-wide): ~3,600 tokens/sec; peak windows (market open) observed 3x spikes (~10k tokens/sec).
Desired throughput guarantee: sustain 20 concurrent sequences at 1024 context with p95 SLA enforced.
Planning reserve: propose 8x A100-equivalent GPUs for primary region (steady+burst capacity) + 2x GPUs for failover/canary.
Batching/caching assumptions: 1) continuous batching with 50ms latency cap; 2) prefix/KV cache expected to reduce tokens/sec by ~18% for repeat sessions.
